63 rules. The same engine runs in the `vulnetix gha` posture commands and in the Software Factory on GitHub App events, so a finding means the same thing in both places. The commands, their flags and the GitHub token each one needs are on [GitHub posture commands](/cli/commands/gha/).

| Context | Meaning |
|---|---|
| needs | The rule only runs when those GitHub facts were read through the API. Without them it is reported as not evaluated, never as passed. |
| uses | The rule runs on the files alone, and reads those facts when present to lower or raise the severity of each finding. |
